messages:
anya: Opening a tiny PR to make the Quickstart truly frictionless. Plan: 3-step flow, canonical env var, and a small docker-compose local path so you can try without an account. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2450
matt: Love it. Paste the auth snippet here so I can cross-check the SDK examples (we still see people using REDWOOD_TOKEN vs REDWOOD_API_KEY).
anya: Current snippet in branch (switching to .env):
```bash
# .env.example
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-REPLACE_ME
REDWOOD_DEFAULT_MODEL=hello-mini
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hello"}'
devrel: Small doc nit: fenced blocks need language for our linter (```bash). Add a one-line caution: trial keys expire in 24h; never commit keys.
anya: Good call. Also replaced long `docker run -e` lists with `--env-file .env` and added a docker-compose entry that runs a lightweight mock server for local testing. Includes a short step: copy .env.example -> .env; docker-compose up; curl localhost:8080/health.
ci-bot: docs build: failed 1 broken link: /getting-started/quick-start -> 404 (redirect mismatch).
matt: I can handle the Netlify redirect alias. We prefer /getting-started/quickstart canonical. I'll push a netlify.toml tweak and re-run linkcheck.
anya: I added a docs-smoke test that runs docker-compose, waits for /health and then performs a sample generate. That should catch regressions where the mock server changes.
ci-bot: docs build: success 1 all checks passed.
devrel: Reviewed and merged. Backported the change to stable-1.0 in PR #2451. I'll also update the onboarding checklist to point to the slim Quickstart.
anya: Thanks all 1 will add a short changelog blurb to the onboarding release notes after the backport lands.
